summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Cango Inc., a Bitcoin miner, reporting its first quarter 2026 unaudited financial results. The filing presents standard quarterly financial and operational metrics, including revenue of US$102.0 million, net loss due to impairment charges, and hashrate details. There are no special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, activism, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or management changes. The filing is a routine earnings report with no triggering corporate action, so it does not qualify as a special situation. No deal terms are applicable.
